result.scope: Manifest, paired fixtures, independent business-state replay, public wire-derived features, request/response hashes, tool byte accounting and held-out confusion matrices. No network requests or inference.
All conditional intervals, held-out cost summaries, exact discordant-pair tests and three separate 12-comparison Holm families. No fitting, new hypotheses or inference requests.
All LR/RF fits, validation selection and frozen/adapted held-out predictions recomputed from the public feature arrays. No inference requests.

pdf_review.review: Assistant visually inspected all three final rendered pages; no overlap or clipping. Build has no undefined references or overfull/underfull boxes.

privacy_review: Fixture source and schemas inspected: generated order identifiers, home/new addresses, numeric synthetic amounts.
Generated planner messages refer only to the synthetic workload; no third-party text corpus or participant data.
Credential-shaped strings scan passed; packet payloads, private TLS keys, credentials, model weights and unrelated records excluded.
scientific_review: All conditions/attack controls retained; validation-only selection; three separate Holm families.
Goal/state distinction and 95/73 completed tasks with state error checked against verified counts.
Visible/hidden path variation separated from nonsignificant aggregate endpoint effects.
Constructed synthetic business writes, supplied tool-call windows, no model-link/timing/WAN guarantee.
Frozen statistics and all raw formal requests verified; separate development unknown excluded without retry.
scope: Only this six-arm synthetic LLM experiment bundle and its three-page result report. Not a gate for the unchanged R101 manuscript or all PR claims.
